description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). Lists your drafts (blog posts, case studies and revisions of live posts), newest first: each one's id, title, kind, state (writing, question_for_you, drafted, checks_failing, ready_to_publish, published and the rest), created and updated dates, preview link and next_action. Filter by state, kind and creation date (created_after, created_before: "yesterday" is the day before the answer's today), and page with cursor. The editor may pass all for everyone's; the site owner, stale: true for his owner queue (drafts stuck over two days). Reads only. Then get_status with an id for one draft in detail.

all.description: The blog's editor only: everyone's drafts, not just yours. Refused for anyone else

created_after.description: Only drafts created at or after this: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, midnight UTC) or an ISO 8601 time with its offset. For yesterday: created_after yesterday's date and created_before today's (the answer's today is the server's date, UTC; pass times with the engineer's offset for their own day)

created_before.description: Only drafts created before this (not at it): a date (YYYY-MM-DD, midnight UTC) or an ISO 8601 time

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

kind.description: Only this kind: post, case-study, or revision (of a live post). Leave it out for all

limit.description: How many to return, newest first (default 20)

stale.description: The site owner only, his owner queue: everyone's drafts with nothing from their author for more than two days (stuck, a question for them, held, drafted or failing checks; never an agent's explainer), oldest wait first. "Show my owner queue" is this. Refused for anyone else

state.description: Only drafts in this state: writing, preview_building, question_for_you, drafted, checking, checks_failing, ready_to_publish, publishing, published, stuck, closed; or open, every one not yet published or closed; or stale, the site owner's queue (as stale: true). Leave it out for all

name: list_drafts

author.description: The byline it was filed under

id.description: The 8-character draft id the other draft tools take

next_action.description: The one next step. Do what instruction says; call is the tool and the arguments the server already knows

owner_queue.description: Only with stale: true: why it is in the owner queue

reason.description: The one-line reason, from its record

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last

partial.description: Present when some drafts' states came from their records because their check runs could not all be read

today.description: The server's date (UTC), to work out yesterday from

total.description: How many drafts match, over every page

title: Your drafts
